source_title: Reliance Industries seeks voluntary strike-off of UK Hamleys subsidiary
source_excerpt:
UK authorities have issued a notice for the proposed dissolution of Hamleys (Franchising) Ltd, which recorded ₹56.08 crore in turnover in 2025 and had nil net worth at year-end.
Reliance Industries has applied for the voluntary strike-off of its UK-based step-down subsidiary Hamleys (Franchising) Ltd, which reported a turnover of ₹56.08 crore in 2025.
